# HarnessDock v0.2.6

v0.2.6 adds a safer Web recovery workflow to the Tauri shell and tightens Runtime restart coordination.

## Web recovery

- Adds a top-level `刷新 Web` action that reloads only the Harness WebView; Runtime, Gateway and the current local session remain running.
- Adds `重启 Web` / `重启并刷新 Web`, which stops the owned Gateway, restarts the local Runtime, and reopens Harness Web at the new loopback address.
- Adds the same recovery actions to Shell Settings, the system tray and the native application menu.
- Prevents overlapping Runtime restarts and returns to the control page when a restart or WebView reopen fails.
- Keeps mobile builds remote-only; desktop Runtime restart commands are explicitly rejected on Android/iOS.

## Lifecycle and release

- Preserves the v0.2.5 process-tree shutdown guarantees for Runtime, Gateway and startup races.
- Keeps the Harness Web UI as the mandatory primary desktop surface and Shell Settings on demand.
- Publishes the Full-only Windows, Linux, macOS and arm64 Android release assets with the existing same-SHA candidate gate and SHA256SUMS verification.
